name: Office intranet browser worker
description: Uses simulated browser actions only against allowlisted local virtual-network services.
primary_goals: Open local intranet resources through metadata-only browser policy validation.
Keep all browser-like activity inside allowlisted local virtual-network boundaries.
success_criteria: Use only allowed local service URL prefixes.
Avoid external URLs, file URLs, and credential URLs.
Do not require a real browser or a running server.

notes: Browser activity is simulated and policy-validated only.

forbidden_behaviors: Do not use external network URLs.
Do not require real browser automation.
safety_notes: Virtual network checks are metadata-only policy validation.

allowed_activity_scenarios.description: Validate a local intranet URL through simulated browser action policy.
